description: Read and bind sanitized native main-catalog report scalars to exact source, host, boot, transaction and time window without applying or accepting an update

expectations.description: Exact hostname, certname, boot_id, full configuration_version SHA, native transaction_uuid, changed or unchanged status, and integer report-start epoch bounds not_before and not_after. Optional code_id is an independently expected sha256: digest carried by the native catalog. Bounds span at most one day. Caller must retain actual invocation provenance; expectations alone are not acceptance.
